home.faq.subtitle: What guests often ask before booking.
home.faq.payment.q: How can I pay on WenGo?
home.faq.payment.a: You pay by international card (Visa, Mastercard…) through Stripe. Card details are encrypted and handled by Stripe — WenGo never stores your card number.
home.faq.cancel.a: It depends on the room. The cancellation policy is shown on each room's page, so check it before you book.
home.faq.bookings.q: Where can I see my bookings?
home.faq.bookings.a: Log in and open "My bookings" from the menu to see the status and details of each booking.
home.faq.otp.q: Do I need a password to log in?
home.faq.otp.a: Not necessarily. You can log in quickly with a one-time OTP code instead of a password.
home.faq.tour.a: At hotels with a tour, you can explore the hallway and each room in full 360° on the hotel page, dragging to look around before you book.
home.faq.wishlist.q: How do I save a hotel for later?
home.faq.wishlist.a: Tap the heart icon to add a hotel to your wishlist, then open it any time from the heart button in the menu.
home.newsletter.title: Get deals first
home.newsletter.text: Leave your email for destination ideas and new deals every month.
home.newsletter.thanks: Thanks! WenGo will email you when new deals arrive.
